verdict.rationale: Temporal supports event-driven automation through code rather than declarative rules. Schedules start Workflow Executions at specified times. Signals and Updates act as message handlers, "akin to endpoints," so running Workflows can react to external events. Activities execute the resulting actions, and retry policies re-run failed work automatically. Missing for 10: a declarative rule/trigger definition (no-code or config-based event→action rules), native external event-source triggers (webhooks, third-party events) that start workflows without custom client code, and independent hands-on corroboration of event-triggered automation.
